thread:
alex_chang: Heads-up — customer ACME-Eng has a support ticket: their SSO-provisioned service account (service-connector) is getting 403s for both embeddings and text-generation endpoints. Ticket says 'insufficient_scopes'.

maria_ops: Ugh. Do we have the provisioner logs? Which scopes were granted by SSO?

samir_cs: From the ticket: their IdP created a service key via our SSO flow. The provisioning response shows scopes: ["embeddings:read", "logs:read"]. They expected full inference scopes.

alex_chang: That explains it. Generation requires "generation:invoke" or "inference:write" (depending on org mapping); embeddings needs "embeddings:write". If the key only has embeddings:read it will 403.

omnia-bot: :information_source: Quick reference: missing scope responses return HTTP 403 with JSON: `{"error":"forbidden","reason":"insufficient_scopes","missing_scopes":["embeddings:write"]}`.

maria_ops: Can we repro with a small curl from my laptop to match their flow? I'll try to simulate the service key.

samir_cs: Please include the Authorization header exactly as the client would: `Authorization: Bearer <service_key>` — some libs accidentally include `Token ` prefix which the control plane rejects.

maria_ops: Repro steps I ran: 
```bash
SERVICE_KEY=sk-xxxx-sim
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SERVICE_KEY" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"small-embed-1","input":"hello"}'
```
Response: 403, body: `{"error":"forbidden","message":"insufficient_scopes","missing_scopes":["embeddings:write"]}`

alex_chang: Perfect repro. So two likely causes: 1) our SSO provisioner mapped IdP role to a minimal set of scopes (policy), or 2) the UI checkbox for "enable inference" wasn't checked in their org's onboarding.

samir_cs: Which part of the provisioner pipeline adds scopes? The bridge service or the initial create-key flow?

omnia-bot: :gear: Provisioning flow: 1) IdP sends attribute assertion -> 2) Provisioner evaluates mapping rules -> 3) Provisioner calls Control Plane /keys/create with scopes param. The mapping rules live in /infra/config/sso-mappings.

maria_ops: I pulled their provisioner audit. It shows: `provisioner.createKey(org_id=acme, default_scopes=[embeddings:read, logs:read])`. The mapping rule for group `svc-general` has `default_scopes: [embeddings:read]` — so it's definitely a mapping issue.

alex_chang: Customer says they need both embeddings and generation from that service connector for their pipeline. They were never told about the mapping.

samir_cs: Next actions: 1) Give them repro steps and the audit snippet, 2) Provide fix instructions for org-admin to re-run provisioning with expanded scopes or manually grant scopes via Console, 3) Add more defensive logging to provisioning so we include a list of requested vs granted scopes in the provision response.

olivia_support: Draft reply to ACME: "Hey — we reproduced the 403. The SSO service key was created with limited scopes (embeddings:read, logs:read). To enable generation and embeddings writes, either (a) an org admin can grant `embeddings:write` and `generation:invoke` to the service key in the Console, or (b) update the IdP provisioning rule to request those scopes and re-provision. We can walk you through the steps." Thoughts?

maria_ops: Add the exact error payload sample and the curl snippet so they can validate. Also include note about service keys vs user tokens (service keys can't get elevated by user consent).

alex_chang: Add a one-liner about propagation delays — policy updates can take up to 30s to apply, so advise them to retry after granting.

samir_cs: Also ask them if they used our SDK — some older SDK versions don't surface `missing_scopes` field and instead return a generic message. If they use SDK < 0.8.2 ask them to upgrade.

omnia-bot: :warning: Suggested response template added to ticket.

olivia_support: I'll send that, include these attachments: provisioning audit snippet, repro curl, required scopes list, and console steps. Also scheduling a quick call if they want a guided re-provision.

maria_ops: For infra: we should add a validate step in the provisioner that, if an assertion requests only `embeddings:read` but the mapping contains `svc-connector` label, we log a warning and tag the key with `missing_inference_scopes=true`.

alex_chang: Good idea. Can we also surface an admin alert in Console UI when a new service key is created with only read scopes?

omnia-bot: :white_check_mark: Logged improvement ticket INFRA-1294: "Provisioner: surface missing inference scopes and include requested vs granted in audit".

samir_cs: Closing loops — Olivia, please paste the reply you send into this thread before you send. I'll add a short how-to doc to KB and link it.

olivia_support: Copy of reply going out now: 
"Hi ACME team — thanks for the report. We reproduced the 403. Our logs show the SSO-provisioned service key only has `embeddings:read` and `logs:read`, which won't allow text-generation or embeddings writes. To fix: 1) Org admin: Console -> Security -> API keys -> select service-connector key -> Edit scopes -> add `embeddings:write` and `generation:invoke`, then Save (changes apply within ~30s). OR 2) Update IdP mapping to include these scopes and re-provision the connector. Sample curl to validate after change: 
```bash
SERVICE_KEY=sk-...
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $SERVICE_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"small-embed-1","input":"test"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
```
If you prefer, we can run the change with you on a quick call. — Olivia (Customer Success)"

alex_chang: Looks good. Send it.

maria_ops: Sent and ticket updated. Marking thread as resolvedPendingCustomer.
